Future SOC Symposium

Dieter Hildebrandt, member of the Computer Graphics Research Group at the Hasso-Plattner-Institut and member of the HPI Research School on “Service Oriented Systems Engineering”, contributed to the Future SOC Symposium 2011, the sixth annual symposium of the HPI Research School, which was held on June 16/17, 2011. Dieter Hildebrandt presented his research work in a talk entitled “Service-Oriented Visualization of Massive 3D Geovirtual Environments”.
